headline: Steamhouse India Limited: Acquisition
sum: Acquisition - Steamhouse India Limited has informed the Exchange about AcquisitionPursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations ), we wish to inform you…
detail: Acquisition - Steamhouse India Limited has informed the Exchange about AcquisitionPursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ( SEBI Listing Regulations ), we wish to inform you that Steamhouse India Limited has incorporated a Wholly-Owned Subsidiary company named "STEAMHOUSE (PANOLI WTS) INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED" on November 06, 2026.
